settings.heading: Descriptions
settings.content:
Meet O'Donnell Moonshine Lime. Zesty lime, cooling cucumber, bold grapefruit and rounding juniper all combine perfectly in this refreshing Moonshine that captures the taste of summer.

Clean, crisp, and endlessly mixable, O'Donnell Lime is made for sunny serves enjoyed in the garden with friends. Whether that's classic cocktails with a twist or simple mixes.

Perfect for everything from mouth-watering Mojitos to mind-blowing Margaritas, the possibilities with Lime are almost endless. Head over to our cocktails recipes for more inspiration.

Bottled in traditional Mason Jars, we promise a unique drinking experience. If you would like to discover more high quality liqueurs, have a look at our entire product range and become part of our Moonshine Gang to collect proof points and get unique benefits.

Curious? Simply order your O'Donnell Lime today and we'll ship it to anywhere within mainland UK within a few working days.

Please note: All of our products are shipped in branded boxes.

settings.heading: Cocktail Recipe
settings.content:
• 100ml Lime Moonshine
  • 50ml Vodka Moonshine
  • Tajin & Chilli seasoning
  • Lime wedge
  • Ice

 Recipe:

  1. Sprinkle the Tajin lime & chilli seasoning onto a small plate.
  2. Rub a wedge of lime around the rim of your glass, then dip into the Tajin to coat the edge with that spicy kick.
  3. Fill your cocktail jar shaker with ice, add a measure of Lime Moonshine and Vodka.
  4. Shake it up until the mix turns cloudy and ice-cold.
  5. Strain into your prepared glass over fresh ice, and garnish with a dehydrated lime slice.
  6. Sip, savour, and feel the heat!

settings.heading: The Perfect Serve
settings.content:
Simple Lime Spritz

Ingredients: 

  • 60ml Lime
  • Soda to Top
  • Ice cubes 
  • Fresh Mint/Lime Segment Garnish

Preparation:

  1. Fill a tumbler or highball glass with ice.
  2. Add a generous measure of Lime
  3. Top with soda to taste
  4. Garnish with a fresh mint and/or a slice of lime.

settings.heading: Allergens
settings.content:
All of our Moonshines, unless indicated otherwise, are allergen free in accordance with Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 and amendments.

All of our spirits are produced using wheat based alcohol. While the distillation process removes gluten from the final product, individuals with certain conditions (i.e coeliac disease) may wish to exercise caution prior to purchase.
